versions.changelog:
Initial release of Kanboard skill with comprehensive JSON-RPC API shell helpers.

- Supports full Kanboard API coverage for projects, tasks, columns, swimlanes, comments, subtasks, users, categories, permissions, and tags.
- Provides shell command templates and usage examples for all common operations.
- Includes detailed authentication instructions for both Application API (token) and User API (login/password).
- Requires only curl and jq for operation.
- Useful as a ready reference or cheatsheet for Kanboard automation and scripting.
